final_prompt: Use case: infographic-story. Asset type: wide cover illustration for a Chinese technology blog article, aspect ratio 2.35:1. Primary request: create a polished conceptual editorial illustration about .NET data formats and query languages. Theme: the shape of data determines how it should be navigated. Reader takeaway: recognize whether a query belongs in the data source or in C# memory objects. Summary angle: flat text, relational tables, XML trees, JSON documents, graph relationships, and in-memory objects each create a different route; LINQ is a common destination with clear execution boundaries. Narrative flow: layered reveal from left to right. Keep one dominant focal subject and three source-grounded beats: flat rows versus relational tables, tree/document/relationship shapes, and different inputs converging into a clean C# object with LINQ. Main metaphor: a sculptural query compass made from data shapes, guiding paths through connected rooms. Primary subject: one dimensional query compass with a central C# object core, visibly guiding the paths. Subject action: the compass routes each data shape toward its native navigation style and then converges into LINQ. Composition/framing: wide horizontal progression, left-side data shapes, central focal compass, right-side convergence into one object; ample negative space, readable silhouette, no collage. Style/medium: conceptual editorial illustration combined with dark gothic illustration, pointed arches, lace shadows, candlelit contrast, ornate black shapes, restrained horror mood; polished, precise, restrained, no imitation of any brand, studio, or living artist. Color palette: charcoal black, aged parchment, muted teal, warm amber. Allow only these short visible labels: CSV / SQL, JSON, LINQ; no poster title, no long captions, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names. Constraints: one clear focal subject, three supporting narrative beats, wide 2.35:1 composition, editorial technology illustration, source-grounded visual logic. Avoid code rain, generic robots, IDE screenshots, dashboards, fake diagrams, fake charts, fake terminal output, fabricated metrics, unrelated icon collage, neon purple-blue overload, decorative clutter, watermark, prompt residue.
